title: Define release artifact provenance subjects
summary: Extend provenance planning for release artifact subjects so future signed releases can bind tag, commit, artifacts, checksums, and validation evidence without choosing key custody yet.
expectedFailureModes: Release provenance binds commits and tasks but not artifacts.

humanEscalation: Human decision remains required for public signing keys and release publication.
